title: Land of the Goblins
start: Talk to Grubfoot in the Dorgeshuun mine, north of Dorgesh-Kaan.

items.t: Ironmen can easily obtain a clean toadflax from the Brimhaven Agility Arena
Black mushroom ink (obtainable during the quest)
Empty vial (if you don't already have the black mushroom ink)
Must have enough backpack space to unequip all items

recommended.t: Activated Ardougne, Draynor, Lumbridge and Port Sarim lodestones
A dramen/lunar staff for using fairy rings (unnecessary if the quest A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed)
A skills necklace for faster travel to the Makeover Mage and Goblin Cave
A Dorgesh-kaan sphere, or 2 law runes and 1 molten glass to trade for one, if not using the fairy rings

rewards.t: Access to the Goblin Temple (with the altar to recharge prayer points)
Access to Yu'biusk, using fairy ring code BLQ
Ability to buy moving-over-distance spheres (plain of mud sphere) that transports you to the goblin cave
Access to the Bandos gravestone (talk to Blasidar the sculptor in Keldagrim)
Ability to access the beacon located near the Goblin Village, west of the Ice Mountain

steps.t: Talk to Grubfoot in the Dorgeshuun Mines. [Chat: 2 Mistag, why won't you let Grubfoot into the city? › 3 I'll take responsibility for Grubfoot. › Accept]

sub.t: Dismiss any familiar or Grubfoot won't follow you.

steps.t: With Grubfoot following, enter Dorgesh-Kaan using the door to the south and head north-west where Oldak is.

In the north-west room, talk to Zanik. [Chat: 3 So why have you come to talk to Zanik? › 3 What was this new dream? › 2 How do you know your dream was true? › Any › 1 I promise not to tell anyone where the temple is. › 1 I'm ready.]
If you forgot to bring the toadflax potion, proceed until Zanik has entered into the temple.

sub.t: Otherwise, you will need to go back to Oldak in Dorgesh-Kaan to meet with her, and provide him two law runes and one molten glass.

steps.t: Once you teleport with Zanik, head north-west to the temple entrance blocked by two goblin guards.

sub.t: Pick and grind a black mushroom into an empty vial if you don't already have black mushroom ink.

steps.t: Talk to the guards and they will allow Zanik to pass into the temple.
Talk to the Makeover Mage south-west of Falador. [Chat: 4 Can you turn me into a goblin? › 1 I need to slip past some goblin guards. › 3 Can you turn me into a goblin or not?]
Use the pharmakos berries on an unfinished toadflax potion to create the goblin potion.

sub.t: (Optional) After making the potion, collect another set of pharmakos berries if planning to complete the Contract Claws mystery.

steps.t: Head to the goblin cave (just north of the Ardougne lodestone).
Unequip all items and dismiss any followers.
In front of the goblin guards, drink the goblin potion (pick any goblin appearance).
Climb down the entrance. [Chat: 1 Me want get into temple. › 1 Yes, I'm [goblin name].]
North, sitting on his throne, talk to the High Priest. [Chat: 1 Can you tell me about Yu'biusk? › 1 I understand the ways of the Big High War God. › 1 I'm ready for the test.]

Take the quiz. [Chat: 1 True. › 1 The Big High War God commands it. › 2 False. › 2 Goblins were not mighty warriors before he chose us. › 2 False. › 1 That's one of the commandments. › 2 Lead goblins to victory over the whole world.]
After the quiz, ask about Yu'biusk. [Chat: 1 Can you tell me about Yu'biusk? › 2 Where is Yu'biusk? › 5 Never mind.]
Dye your goblin mail black with the mushroom ink.
Wear the black goblin mail and go in the north-east room by talking to the goblin in the passage.
Pickpocket the priest for a key. Keep this key. You will need it later.
Search the crate in the room to find the teleport sphere.
Talk to Zanik in the prison cell to the north-west of the crate, she will teleport. [Chat: 1 I have a teleport sphere here.]
Leave the cave.

sub.t: You can equip a piece of equipment to be thrown out, then you can teleport to Draynor.

steps.t: Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village. Ask her about black or white dye. [Chat: 4 More... › 2 Can you make dyes for me please? › 4 Can you make black or white dye?]

sub.t: Or, if Vampyre Slayer is complete. [Chat: 5 More... › 2 Can you make dyes for me please? › 4 Can you make black or white dye?]

steps.t: Teleport to Seers' Village lodestone and head south-west to Hemenster near the Ranging Guild. Alternatively, use a combat bracelet.

sub.t: Be sure to have a raw slimy eel or you will have to repeat the next steps.

steps.t: Attempt to open the gate near Morris. [Chat: 3 I need to catch a Hemenster whitefish.]
After finishing the dialogue, open the gate.
Catch a whitefish.
Return to Aggie and use the goblin mail on her.
Unequip any items and dismiss any followers.
Go back to the goblin temple entrance, take a sip of your goblin potion, and equip your white goblin mail.
Enter the temple.
Steal the white key from the priest in the room west of the temple.

sub.t: Remove the goblin mail to leave the room quicker.

steps.t: Repeat the operation of stealing keys, dying your mail in the following order:

sub.t: Yellow (north-west)
Purple (south-west)
Orange (south-east)
Blue (east)

steps.t: Enter the crypt (large door north of the temple).
Prepare for battle by equipping weapons and armour.
Use the Say-name option on each of the graves. After killing them, talk to them.

sub.t: South-west: Snothead [Chat: 1 Where is Yu'biusk? › 1 What was your predecessor's name? › 4 Goodbye.]
South-east: Snailfeet [Chat: 2 Snailfeet › 2 What was your predecessor's name?]
North-west: Mosschin [Chat: 3 Mosschin › 2 What was your predecessor's name?]
North-east: Redeyes [Chat: 4 Redeyes › 2 What was your predecessor's name?]
North: Strongbones (ignore his skeleton minions) [Chat: 5 Strongbones]

steps.t: Talk to Strongbones after defeating him. [Chat: 1 Where is Yu'biusk? › 4 Goodbye.]
Return to Dorgesh-Kaan and speak with Zanik in the north-west (Oldak's lab).
With a light source, head to the south end of Dorgesh-Kaan using fairy code AJQ. Alternatively, without using fairy rings:

sub.t: Go up the stairs to the agility course.
At the start of the agility course, climb down the ladder west of the agility cable.
Follow the cave path east then south to the Fairy ring.

steps.t: Adjust the machines next to Oldak, use combination 9-4-1, activate the machine.
Open the strange box in the north-western part of Yu'biusk for a cutscene.
Continue dialogue with Oldak.
Quest complete!
